verdict.rationale: Asking whether a state business-filing service publishes its account, credential, and identity-proofing prerequisites up front is a fair question, so the axis applies. The evidence pack contains only robots.txt probes showing bot walls (Akamai 403, Incapsula interstitials) on www.nvsos.gov and the ORION portal. None of it documents any published statement of account, credential, or identity-proofing steps required before filing.
